tasks.title: Bind Before You Burn: facts state the proposition the package makes actionable
tasks.spec: The Config flag `bind_evidence: bool = False` ALREADY EXISTS in proto/engine.py Config (do not add it). The final variant G8u uses the legacy path of PracticeNegotiator.facts_for (safe_claims and claim_provenance_only are off). When self.cfg.bind_evidence is true, change ONLY the wording of two fact kinds in PracticeNegotiator.facts_for (same data IDs, same order, same count, so the claim budget is unchanged): (a) fact 4 (our recent order lines with this supplier, `pos` ids): read qty and order_date of exactly those po_lines ids with q(...) (table po_lines has columns id, qty, order_date, price, price_unit, part_id, supplier_id - verify against how the bundling code in PracticeNegotiator.write queries qty/order_date); if every id has a numeric qty and a date, the sentence becomes: 'Our orders {ids} total {sum qty:,.0f} pieces between {min month YYYY-MM} and {max month YYYY-MM}: steady demand that our package now turns into a binding volume, which lowers your risk and your cost per piece'. If any value is missing keep the original sentence. (b) fact 6 (a forecast that grows): 'Our forecast {r} shows demand {change:+.1f}%; our package commits the full requirement of {self.b["need_per_year"]:,} pieces per year, so that growth is secured volume for you'. Only state the commitment when 'volume_per_year' is in self.case.get('negotiable', []) or the case fixes the volume (fixed_terms has volume_per_year); otherwise keep the original sentence. Never state a number that is not computed from the data or case. Keep everything else byte-identical when the flag is off.
tasks.test: smoke (proto/smoke.py) with V=I1 and sandbox D01/D02 vs G8u

tasks.title: Verify, Then Settle: evidence-first layout and a verify-then-assess request (two flags)
tasks.spec: Config flags `verify_layout: bool = False` and `verify_request: bool = False` ALREADY EXIST in proto/engine.py Config (do not add them). G8u uses the legacy branch of PracticeNegotiator.write (after `msg = super().write(t, rnd, sheets, rival)`). Add a small helper `_verify_settle(self, t, rnd, msg)` called at the very end of the legacy branch, just before `return msg` (after _no_dup_claims and the text_fixes dedupe). It only acts when rnd >= 1, msg has term_sheets and at least one ref. verify_layout: split the body into its lines/sentences; the 'evidence sentences' are those that contain one of msg['refs'] (exact ID string) and are not part of the greeting or sign-off; move those evidence sentences, in their original order, into one block placed directly after the greeting line (the first non-empty line), followed by a blank line, then the rest of the body unchanged. Never alter, drop or duplicate any sentence; the multiset of sentences must be identical (assert-like check: if the rebuilt body's sorted sentence list differs from the original, keep the original body and self.note('verify_settle_failed', ...)). verify_request: insert the line 'Please verify these inputs first, then assess the attached package; if you counter, please reflect any applicable adjustment in your primary term sheet.' directly before the sign-off ('\nBest regards' as used elsewhere in this file; if not found, append at the end before nothing changes). Each flag must work alone and together. self.note('verify_settle', supplier=t.sid, layout=..., request=...) when it acts. No new refs, no new numbers, no attachments.
tasks.test: smoke with V=I3 and sandbox D01/D02 vs G8u; check bodies in logs

tasks.title: Quote-implied exchange rate package (MESO hook)
tasks.spec: Config flag `quote_exchange: bool = False` ALREADY EXISTS and MESO_HOOKS ALREADY contains ('quote_exchange', '_quote_exchange_package'): do NOT edit Config or MESO_HOOKS. Write only the new method `def _quote_exchange_package(self, t, c_goal, picks):` on Negotiator, inserted immediately BEFORE the line `    def meso(self, t, c_goal):` (use that line as the unique anchor: old = that line, new = your method + blank line + that line). Contract: (t, c_goal, picks) -> new picks list or None (None = unchanged). Logic: single supplier only (len(self.threads) == 1) and len(picks) >= 2 and not stabilise (self.b.get('category_goal') == 'stabilise' -> None). Look at the supplier's LATEST message in t.events (from not in ('buyer','arena')) with >= 2 term_sheets. For every pair of its sheets, complete both with complete_offer(self.case, terms); if they differ in unit_price and in exactly ONE other negotiable field f (compare the completed dicts on keys in self.case['negotiable'] other than unit_price), that pair is a quoted exchange: per the supplier, switching f from value vA to vB changes the price by dp = pB - pA. Take picks[0] (completed); if picks[0][f] == vA and vB is an allowed option, candidate = picks[0] with f = vB and unit_price = round(picks[0]['unit_price'] + dp, 2); symmetric if picks[0][f] == vB (switch to vA with price - dp). Keep the candidate only if must_haves_ok(self.case, cand, t.std), unit_price > 0, self.C(t, cand) < self.C(t, complete_offer(self.case, picks[0])) (cheaper for us at the supplier's own quoted rate) and it is not identical to any pick. Choose the cheapest such candidate; return [picks[0], cand] + picks[2:]. self.note('quote_exchange', supplier=t.sid, field=f, rate=dp, c_primary=..., c_cand=...). Wrap the body in try/except: on error self.note('quote_exchange_failed', ...) and return None. Use the existing helpers complete_offer, must_haves_ok, self.C exactly as the neighbouring hooks (_clause_buyout_package, _adopted_lane_package) use them.
tasks.test: smoke with V=I4, offline trigger check on logs with alternative sheets, sandbox D01/D02 vs G8u

tasks.title: Spend seconds, not replies: RFQ counter waits briefly for an in-flight rival reply
functions: the RFQ worker loop actually used by the variant G8u (rfq_stagger=True, legacy RFQ path)
tasks.spec: Config flag `rival_defer: bool = False` ALREADY EXISTS (do not add it). First find which RFQ code path G8u runs (its flags: rfq_stagger True, rfq_meso_n 1, rfq_facts 1, rfq_holds 0, rfq_pushes 3, rival True, safe_exceptions True, text_fixes True; NOT safe_single/close_recovery_v2/sealed rounds) - follow Negotiator.run -> run_rfq and the per-thread worker it starts. In that worker, immediately before an ORDINARY counter is built and sent on an open thread (not a push after a final offer, not an accept/close/mirror, not the opening message), add: if self.cfg.rival_defer and the thread status is 'open' and some OTHER live thread x has x.in_flight True (our message to x sent, its reply not yet in) and the best standing C of the other threads is >= this thread's standing C (weak current rival leverage) and not self.near_cap() and this thread's remaining seconds (60 - (time.time() - t.replied_at), or the thread's seconds_left if available as elsewhere in that loop) minus max(20, self.slowest + 15) is > 3: then wait, polling every 0.5 s WITHOUT holding any lock, until that rival is no longer in_flight or the budget min(20, remaining - max(20, self.slowest + 15)) is spent or self.near_cap(). At most one thread may defer at a time (a threading.Lock-protected flag on self, e.g. self.__dict__['_rival_defer_busy']) and each thread at most once per round (store the round on t.__dict__). After waiting, recompute whatever the worker computes before building the counter (goal, best standing, rival citation) - simplest: `continue` the worker loop so it re-evaluates with fresh state, but make sure the defer cannot trigger again for this round. self.note('rival_defer', supplier=t.sid, waited=..., rival=x.sid, arrived=bool). Never defer an agreed/final_offer thread or any closing action. Flag off: byte-identical behaviour.
tasks.test: smoke, sandbox D02 x4 vs G8u, and final.py --rehearse with --latency 5,25

tasks.title: Same-cost concession carrier (MESO hook)
tasks.spec: Config flag `same_cost_carrier: bool = False` ALREADY EXISTS and MESO_HOOKS ALREADY contains ('same_cost_carrier', '_same_cost_carrier_package'): do NOT edit Config or MESO_HOOKS. Write only the new method `def _same_cost_carrier_package(self, t, c_goal, picks):` on Negotiator, inserted immediately BEFORE the line `    def _clause_buyout_package(self, t, c_goal, picks):` (anchor: old = that line; new = your method + blank line + that line). Hypothesis being tested: the supplier bots mirror our VISIBLE unit-price step. Logic: single supplier only, len(picks) >= 2, not stabilise, t.rounds >= 1 (there is a previous buyer primary). prev_price = unit_price of our previous primary sheet (latest buyer event in t.events with term_sheets; its first sheet's terms). C0 = self.C(t, complete_offer(self.case, picks[0])). Search the allowed package grid: for g in lever_grid(self.case, {**t.std, **(t.sheets[0]['terms'] if t.sheets else {})}) filtered by must_haves_ok(self.case, g, t.std) (exactly as _meso_core builds its grid; also respect lead_cap if the core does), solve the unit price that gives total cost C0 with price_for_c(self.case, {k: v for k, v in g.items() if k != 'unit_price'}, t.std, C0, t.est if self.relationship and t.est else None) (same call as _clause_buyout_package); keep candidates with a finite price, price > picks[0]['unit_price'], price <= the supplier's current standing unit price (t.sheets[0]['terms']['unit_price']), complete_offer(...) must_haves_ok, and abs(self.C(t, cand) - C0) <= 0.002 * C0. Pick the candidate with the HIGHEST unit price (largest visible step up from prev_price at the same cost to us) and return [picks[0], cand] + picks[2:]; None if no candidate or the step is not at least 0.5 % larger than picks[0]'s step (price - prev_price vs picks[0]['unit_price'] - prev_price). self.note('same_cost_carrier', supplier=t.sid, primary_price=..., carrier_price=..., c=C0, terms=...). try/except -> self.note('same_cost_carrier_failed', ...) and None.
tasks.test: smoke with V=I6, sandbox D01/D02 vs G8u
